How a project runs

You see something working early and every version after. Nothing goes live until it has been tested on real phones.

STEP 1

Map the paper trail

We walk through the current form or sheet: who fills it, who signs it, where it gets stuck.

STEP 2

Build in versions

You preview each version and say what to change. The church tracker went through six.

STEP 3

Test everything

Automated checks on every rule, plus real clicks on desktop and phone before each release.

STEP 4

Hand it over

The app lives in your Google account with a guide tab in the sheet. Your data stays yours.
